summary: Added sdk/policy (progression.py, __init__.py) with DesignData (parsed from RoomDesign and ResearchDesign records), PolicyConfig (mineral and gas reserves, allow_starbux_spend, max_requests), ActionRequest, Rejection, Plan and a policy registry. baseline-v1 orders research (first open design per research line, skipping busy lines and, unless allowed, starbux-priced designs), then room upgrades for rooms with an upgrade design (each followed by collect_all_resources, as upgradeRooms does), then the daily reward. Every candidate must pass its catalog preconditions; costs are checked against observed balances minus reserves and deducted cumulatively; unobserved sections and balances produce rejections, not actions; training is reported as not modelled. Added 12 tests and docs/baseline/progression-policy.md, which lists the differences from run.py.

contract_status_changes.before: Progression decisions exist only as imperative code inside run.py and Client methods
contract_status_changes.after: A pure, versioned planner whose baseline-v1 reproduces run.py's order, returning explained requests and rejections

residual_risks: baseline-v1 omits crew training and every run.py step outside the catalog, so it covers only part of today's routine.
Research prerequisites such as lab level are not modelled; the server may reject a planned research (LAB_UPGRADE_REQUIRED), which the runner journals as unknown.
Room and research design attribute names come from existing client code, not a live capture.
